# Unit economics and 30/60/90-day scenarios (generated by unit_economics.py)

All figures are **ESTIMATES** built from the inputs in the script. CAC/CPA is an assumption and must be validated with real ad tests.

Common assumptions: VAT 19% (DE); payment fees 2.5% + €0.25; fixed costs €450/month.
